title: The open-closed triangle of a Weil complex exists
statement: Let $k_0$ be a finite field, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ a prime, and $X$ a $k_0$-scheme that is locally of finite type, quasi-compact and quasi-separated over $k_0$. Use the triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] of Weil complexes on $X$ [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Let $j\colon U\to X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and $i\colon Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] over $k_0$ whose images are complementary. For every Weil complex $K$ on $X$ there is a distinguished triangle $T_1\to T_2\to T_3\to T_1[1]$ with $T_1\cong j_!j^*K$, $T_2\cong K$ and $T_3\cong i_*i^*K$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-native-weil-open-closed-triangle] to the given $k_0,\ell,X,j,i,K$. Its category is precisely the native category specified in the statement, not fixed pairs in a geometric derived category. Its hypotheses are exactly the given local finite type, quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, quasi-compact open immersion and complementary closed immersion over $k_0$. Obtain a distinguished triangle $S$ in that category, together with isomorphisms $e_1:S_1\cong Rj_{0!}j^*K$, $e_2:S_2\cong K$ and $e_3:S_3\cong Ri_*i^*K$. This existing node asserts the triangle before any compactly supported direct image is applied; no separatedness of $X$ over $k_0$ is required.

source.place: First sentence: existence of the localization triangle; native derived-Weil realization specified by LowerShriekFunctoriality.lean:171-181.

proof.text: Set $T=S$. In [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], the operations denoted here by $j_!$ and $i_*$ on Weil complexes are the native restricted derived operations $Rj_{0!}$ and $Ri_*$. Thus $e_1,e_2,e_3$ have exactly the three required endpoints. Keep the distinguished arrows of $S$, and use these three isomorphisms as witnesses of their respective nonempty isomorphism types. The requested conclusion follows; it prescribes only vertices, so there is no additional assertion about the counit or unit arrows.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_openClosed (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    [j.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [i.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] (hij : IsCompl (Set.range j.base) (Set.range i.base))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] (K : WeilComplex k₀ l X) :
    ∃ T ∈ distTriang (WeilComplex k₀ l X),
      Nonempty (T.obj₁ ≅ (derivedLowerShriek k₀ l j).obj ((upperStar j).obj K)) ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj₂ ≅ K) ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj₃ ≅ (derivedLowerStar i).obj ((upperStar i).obj K)) :=
  sorry
